queries.compiledQueryString: select distinct year from f1.team_standings order by year desc
queries.inputQueryString: select distinct year from f1.team_standings order by year desc

queries.compiledQueryString:
select round_number, short_name, team_name, team_colour, points_scored
from f1.team_standings
where year = ${inputs.season.value}
order by round_number, championship_position
queries.inputQueryString:
select round_number, short_name, team_name, team_colour, points_scored
from f1.team_standings
where year = ${inputs.season.value}
order by round_number, championship_position

queries.compiledQueryString:
select team_name, arg_max(team_colour, round_number) as team_colour from (select round_number, short_name, team_name, team_colour, points_scored
from f1.team_standings
where year = ${inputs.season.value}
order by round_number, championship_position) group by 1
queries.inputQueryString: select team_name, arg_max(team_colour, round_number) as team_colour from ${round_points} group by 1

queries.compiledQueryString:
select count(*) filter (stop_duration_s is not null) as timed_stops
from f1.pit_stops where year = ${inputs.season.value}
queries.inputQueryString:
select count(*) filter (stop_duration_s is not null) as timed_stops
from f1.pit_stops where year = ${inputs.season.value}

queries.compiledQueryString:
select
    team_name,
    any_value(team_colour)                          as team_colour,
    round(median(stop_duration_s), 2)               as median_stop_s,
    round(min(stop_duration_s), 2)                  as fastest_stop_s,
    count(*)                                        as stops,
    avg((stop_duration_s < 2.5)::int)              as sub_2_5s_pct
from f1.pit_stops
where year = ${inputs.season.value}
  and stop_duration_s between 1.5 and 10   -- drops penalties and problem stops
group by team_name
order by median_stop_s
queries.inputQueryString:
select
    team_name,
    any_value(team_colour)                          as team_colour,
    round(median(stop_duration_s), 2)               as median_stop_s,
    round(min(stop_duration_s), 2)                  as fastest_stop_s,
    count(*)                                        as stops,
    avg((stop_duration_s < 2.5)::int)              as sub_2_5s_pct
from f1.pit_stops
where year = ${inputs.season.value}
  and stop_duration_s between 1.5 and 10   -- drops penalties and problem stops
group by team_name
order by median_stop_s

queries.compiledQueryString:
select stop_duration_s, team_name, driver_name, meeting_name, lap_number
from f1.pit_stops
where year = ${inputs.season.value} and stop_duration_s >= 1.5
order by stop_duration_s
limit 10
